messages:
sophia: Heads-up — I pulled the 2026-03-01 invoice batch and found a few customers missing GPU compute line items and two invoices that share the same invoice_id. @tom @raj can one of you check billing-render logs?

tom: looking now. which customers?

sophia: sample IDs: cust_8921, cust_1102 (both missing gpu lines). Duplicate invoice_id: `inv_20260301_907` appears for two different accounts.

raj: that's strange — we usually dedupe invoice ids. billing-bot, show the last 3 runs for generator_v2 please.

billing-bot: generator_v2 runs:
- 2026-03-01T02:00Z status=success id=run_984
- 2026-03-01T02:15Z status=partial id=run_985 warnings=render_skip_for_missing_usage
- 2026-03-01T02:45Z status=success id=run_986

tom: run_985 contains "render_skip_for_missing_usage" — looks like a subjob dropped GPU usage rows. pulling CDC logs now.

liam: finance-ops: please hold on sending the two affected invoices. we'll need corrected versions. :warning: do not trigger collections for these accounts until cleared.

raj: found the root cause candidate: PR #4310 changed the usage_exporter serializer and unintentionally omitted `gpu_hours` when `usage_type=spot`. tagging @eng-runtime for a quick triage.

sophia: plan: @eng-runtime either rollback PR #4310 or patch serializer. @tom prepare a re-run plan: regenerate invoices for run_985 (range) and produce corrected invoices labeled with suffix `-rev1`. finance: hold collections for cust_8921 and cust_1102. I'll draft a short incident note after fix.

tom: will run validation preflight then re-run generator for the affected range. will post updates here when done.

sophia: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick response. :heart:
